title: O God, Unseen, Yet Ever Near

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: O God, unseen, yet ever near,
While we in love that hath no fear,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Here may Thy faithful people know
The streams that thro'  the dessert  flow,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: We come, obedient to Thy Word
Our meat, the body of our Lord,

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: Thus may we all Thy words obey,
For we, O God, are Thine,
And go rejoicing on our way,
